action.description: Action to perform, with the parameter it reads: 'spawn' task; 'spawn_batch' tasks; 'join' batch_id; 'list' none; 'kill' run_id; 'history' run_id; 'steer' run_id + message; 'chat_sessions' none; 'chat_assign' session_id + task. Defaults to 'spawn' when omitted.

agent.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': identity agent name. Available: (none configured)

allow_delegation.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': explicitly request a strictly narrower, sealed sessions_spawn grant for this child. Requires operator permission; supports one further level with one child per recursive grant, retaining the selected provider/model pins.

announce.description: For 'spawn', default true: whether the sub-agent posts its own result to the channel. A 'spawn_batch' member never announces; collect a batch with 'join' and report it once.

batch_id.description: For 'join': the batch identifier returned by 'spawn_batch'. 'join' blocks until every member has finished, however long that takes.

disposition.description: For 'chat_assign': how to handle a turn that session is already running. 'queue' (default) waits, 'steer' feeds the task to the running turn, 'interrupt' stops it first. Prefer 'queue'.

last_n.description: For 'history': return the last N entries (default 20, keeping final proof markers visible).

max_chars_per_entry.description: For 'history': maximum characters per returned entry (default 800).

message.description: For 'steer': text injected into an already-running sub-agent to redirect it. Not how work is handed out — 'spawn' and 'chat_assign' take their instructions in `task`.

mode.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': 'task' runs in-process (default), 'process' launches an isolated OS process.

model.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': model override. Defaults to the gateway model.

provider.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': provider override. Must be a provider the operator configured (the gateway provider, a named agent's provider, a fallback provider or a model route); any other provider, including an unconfigured 'custom:<url>', is refused. Defaults to the agent config provider, then the gateway provider.

recipient.description: For 'spawn': recipient (phone number, group ID, …) of the result announcement and any kill notice; defaults to the current sender. Under 'spawn_batch' it routes only the kill notice. 'chat_assign' always replies into the assigning conversation.

run_id.description: Sub-agent run id returned by 'spawn' and listed by 'list'. Required by 'kill', 'history' and 'steer'. Not a chat session id.

session_id.description: For 'chat_assign': the live `prx chat` session that gets the task, as listed by 'chat_sessions'. A chat session id, not a sub-agent run_id.

task.description: The work to be done, as instructions. Required by 'spawn' and by 'chat_assign' ('chat_assign' has no `message`, `prompt` or `text` parameter). Use `tasks` for 'spawn_batch' and `message` for 'steer'.

tasks.description: For 'spawn_batch': tasks to launch together. Ordinary batches have no fixed member cap; recursive grants permit one child. Each entry is a task string or an object {task, agent?, model?, provider?, allow_delegation?, mode?, recipient?}; any other key is rejected. Top-level parameters are per-entry defaults that an entry key overrides. Members never announce their own results: call 'join' with the returned batch_id and report them yourself.

allow_delegation.description: For 'spawn' and 'spawn_batch': explicitly request a strictly narrower, sealed sessions_spawn grant for this child. Requires operator permission; supports one further level with one child per recursive grant, retaining the selected provider/model pins.
